title: Jaggery
body:
Sugarcane sap to glace,
candy-confectionery.
Pumping hot, boiling, and thriving
Rages and coloring every edge
Bright Red.
Melting sweet-silkily in maws.
Delighting the skies, eyes, and center
of thighs,
on a platter marvelously it lies.
Slippering through the upstairs comes
down and the intestine fills with
butterflies.
Scorching shivers, elation, and
contentment everything combines.
Leaving tongue/soul all sweet-sugary,
Honey, you must be jaggery.

title: The Labyrinth and the Mathematician
body:
I am labyrinth-like,
Diophantine Equation and
My mathematician pulls a string,
I fall in his arms like every time,
Lights my heart with his shiny tiny
eyes,
And I go crazy as I'll never get blinded
again, I do though.
I sleep back to the sadness he comes
and kisses me fireworks start to
glisten above my heart.
My savior, my warrior
Comes shattering every web,
Salvation to my every bit
When he calls my name, "babe".
If I shall be labyrinth he runs through
me,
Lives in me and keeps my heart
beating.

title: The Last 3000 Letters
body:
I'll write the last 3000 letters to my
darling.
Knowing that never post them,
They'll get shredded by the postman,
Knowing they don't have the address
on them.
We fell apart cause I gave up.
I'll give up to someone lucky,
Knowing that I had you first,
Luckily?
Darling, it was good
But I had to choose
Between you and my dignity.

title: The Dagger
body:
Deep red river,
The sharpest edge going deeper and
deeper,
Takes it all in.
It's a black hole but bloody,
Rips it all mercilessly,
Slicing flesh and skin,
So deep-rooted and engraving the
bottomless.
Edge of it-
Crushing-slaughtering,
There's no end to it
Nor to the pain or edge
Lancing till liberation,
Honey, keep the dagger or me.

title: On Your Own
body:
Kid! You're on your own.
Hurricanes, tsunamis, volcanoes,
In a horrible epoch, between bitter
plants, you rose.
Love kidnappers come for you now
and then,
Loved the moon unconditionally, they
couldn't even give me stars.
The scar on my head, a proof that I
bleed invisibly,
A hundred band-aids for thousand
cuts,
Crying out the burning lava,
This time I see myself sleeping
through the storm,
But my hut is at stake,
So I pat-slap myself when I think
about the ones that eloped.
In this haunting globe,
You are all alone!
Kid, you're on your own.

title: To Bury or to Save?
body:
Enormous complex diction box,
Plucking one or two leaf names,
She, who gets entangled in brown
tangles?
Surfs in salty suffering waters,
Stands up with coppery shiny skin,
Again!
Dangling bloody clothes on
sandalwood,
Crawling back to the old dark cave.
Rise again to find the rose of the
century,
Stamping footprints on sunflower
fields.
She flies and flies,
Until she gets pulled by it,
In salty waters again,
By the sleeping monster of the cave,
The same name to encounter,
To bury or to save?

title: A Blessing or a Trap?
body:
Leaving behind,
A living nightmare.
Napping mindlessly and
Grabbing his glance from the mirror,
A blessing or a trap?
Now I can't fall asleep in
4th dimension,
Without resting my head on his lap.
A few flashes of swoon,
Already sold my soul to him to swap.
Oh lord, what will become of me?
Tremendous bliss,
Or a load of crap?

title: Peace Without Peacefulness
body:
I wanna roam around in sunflower
fields,
a tiara of tulips on my head,
Evaporating my all suspicions in
nature's shower.
Bordering my home with blossoms,
As the questioning creature that I am,
I would climb up on the restricted
Mountain,
Jump into the black waters,
I would hustle to catch the moon
every night.
Wandering all day all night,
I dare to get disappear in a swoon,
Plucking every flower and tasting
every fruit,
It might get me into trouble one day,
How I desire peace without
peacefulness.

title: Love
body:
"Love",
Youth running behind it,
My one mate toiling behind it just to
blame fate,
And I, running behind it since I don't
remember,
The others, making fun of it and
crying inside.
And I, look for another belief to beat it
To beat, I've got to feel it.
Look for love in every stranger's eye,
End up questioning everything,
Why?
Possibly, it's elusive to me,
To everyone?
Must be a synonym for happiness,
Cause as I prey on it and it flies,
Love must be a butterfly.

title: Before Creating the Sea
body:
Keeping one's nose clean
Brat showing civility by
Drying the green paint in the field and
brushing colours in the sky.
Sewing buttons in our eyes,
Tricked us into drinking the meng po
soup,
Couldn't airbrush our scars,
Drought, tsunamis and unjust wars.
Bones, blood and tears,
What a serene scene to see!
And we worship our overlords to flee.
The first condition is to be pirates
before creating the sea.

title: Counting My Miseries
body:
Sitting all over the house,
Sometimes in a chair or by the
window,
You know, watching people,
Having fun and dancing their whole
lives,
Spicy like mum's achar
Weeknd tunes, Tesla and New York
bars,
Falling in love and walking through
the galleries,
And I sit here counting my miseries.
I have happy flowers in my midst
Watering me and keeping me healthy,
But I've got so many griefs making me
wealthy.
Still sitting beside the window, Trying
to simmer life from poor poetry.

title: Falling Meteorites
body:
We,
Two falling and burning meteorites,
Unifying day by day into each other,
Half burned, it'll burn us to ashes,
Face to face,
I'm just trying to catch your breath.
Drooling over your drool and dancing
on your letters,
Steaming souls on late-night chatters,
Heaven is found in the one who
shatters.
Let's look at how long our resistance
will last,
Without our hands weaved together.

title: The Underworld Crown
body:
In their eyes,
You've hit the rock bottom this time,
A head-crushing fall,
But little did they know,
You've earned the underworld crown
by perishing 3 times.
Your sufferance
And veins hold running wines,
You'll be running hard and fall on the
ground half dead,
Numb and null.
But dare to believe me,
After reaping of the band-aid,
Fading in air,
You'll look back and will see a life well
spent
Only if you bloom vastly minimizing all
the miseries

title: This Little Cement Garden of Ours
body:
This little cement garden of ours,
Home of all wretched people.
A house of welcoming creepers,
With a loving gardener.
To the Bruised, angry, innocent,
impostors,
Drenching all of us in love.
Bred and brought up by him,
I'd jump the gun to make him smile.
He got me through the storms and
droughts.
Oblivious, I lost myself to
nothingness,
I fought, fought and fought to breathe,
Without him,
Before I could discern the curse,
I was handling the watering can,
He got filled up in my brain and veins.

title: Metaphors
body:
Metaphors,
I give metaphors to most of my
troubles.
Like, For standing under the shower
and couldn't breathe, I would blame
the anxiety.
I write too many poems, but no
variety.
As an amateur in the 'Great poets
society.
Well, life's not going in quite a sync,
So, I forget how to use the syntax.
But mostly I let it go,
And all of the silent songs in me,
I let it flow.
Every day I give myself a challenge,
To go write it all,
And I end up writing about my fall.
Rubbish I write myself is a taunt,
Replicating Swift, Sylvia and
Shakespeare,
Hearing them mumble, I haunt.
Even, though I don't know what I
want,
Or what I've got.
So yes,
I let it go,
I let it all flow.

title: The Portrait of You
body:
Oh my good heavens!
That I don't believe in,
I reaped it all,
When I gazed into those heavenly
pairs of eyes,
For the first time,
I couldn't believe it,
The second time I got the urge to
repeat it.
5000 inches away thriving you,
But the scent caught me off-guard at 5
inches.
Those smiling lips,
Holding the rose bouquet,
instead of handing my frail heart.
Voiding the authority of your
crystal-like pair.
Yet to seek approval,
Turned back for the one last look at
those pleasant pairs,
Alas! Nobody was there,
But the portrait of you remains in my
eyes.
Maybe till tomorrow?
Or forever who knows.

title: Love of the Century
body:
Evaporating in a black shadow,
Aliens crowding around me,
No one happy to converse
In this grassland of cynical zombies,
Would it be alright to desire the love
of the century?
Where you don't need to talk but you
still do,
Someone who will hold your hand in
a world curfew,
Singing while walking on the night
footpath,
Exchanging ensuring smiles in wack
parties,
slow-dancing on the same old-new
songs under yellow sunshine,
Watching the same rom-com every
weekend with wine,
I want to be high on those eyes,
Without any timeline,
Is that too hard to find?
Would it be alright if I'd want to make
you mine?
Would it be alright?
If I could look for the one my whole
life?

title: The Fishbowl
body:
Sudden urge to crush the fishbowl
that we used to swim in,
Our Suffocating glorious nest,
Maybe...
I'm not the ideal one for it.
Went out for a smoke,
And I'll merrily let it swallow me.
I don't want to abandon you,
But I won't let you allow me.
I'll adopt 'buddha's rubbish' as a
shield,
And you're love-longing will follow me,
After making love for the everlasting
night,
If I reject you,
Confess, that I am cruel and unkind,
I'm wandering on paths which are
treacherously curled,
Maybe Apocalypse,
If they ask about me, tell them
I'm the worst person in the world.

title: Precious Phase
body:
I can't draw this on paper,
But what about my drowning heart,
This doesn't even feel like drowning,
It just feels like you drawing on my
heart or my mind,
Unbelievable, there is a soul in the
world so loving and kind!
My heart is full and I'm loving the air I
breathe,
There are not many people that I feel
at peace with.
The sandcastle we're putting together,
I don't wanna crack it.
This moment and the feeling that I am
getting I just wanna save it.
All of our fears, troubles and tears I
wanna embrace.
I wanna relive it forever and ever, this
precious phase.

title: Barren Land
body:
Laying here in a cold room with
others.
Began growing up on a fairground
and an evil nimbus gets to me,
Mugs my gardeners away,
Puts me in a sunless underground
hut.
Neither it lets me breathe nor sob,
Constantly torturing with a vicious
giggle in choking silence,
The worst form of violence.
Lost my voice without even shouting,
sacrificed my sun, water and pals,
More on counting.
Unable to flee this wetland,
Afraid of turning in the sand,
Suppose I get out too,
all I've got is nothing but barren land.

title: Parasite
body:
Dwelling like a parasite,
Planting all the love letters that you
showed me, under my bed.
Aware of the fact,
You wrote it all for your darlings.
Every night I listen to the song,
Which doesn't belong to me
I still do the thrifting of hearts,
After tons of warnings.
Loving someone else's love,
Occasionally, a dark cloud on the
head above.
Lends unfamiliar ache,
But I mostly survive.
Wake up with new hopes in the
twilight,
But I didn't lie when I said,
I am a parasite.

title: The Pink Wax World
body:
Hey love, got stitches where
my head hit your fantasy.
My first honey, maybe we were there
just to fill the vacancy.
Now you linger as dried blood tinted
on my hair.
The mirror ball that I exhibited to the
world,
Slowly cracking and dying.
As I feared,
We?
As we stressed,
Our pink wax world is melting from my
never-ending hypocrisy,
You had to get acquitted as you held it
all with delicacy.
And I got punished with a charge of
robbery,
Our peace,
Happy us.
Couldn't help but be a curse.
I won't trouble you anymore with my
lullabies,
Only hush.
I'm not even gonna get over this bad
drug,
I'll wait for you to collect our stories
and flush.
Eternally.

title: Sweet Poison
body:
You swept a spoon full of sweet
poison in my morning tea, or the air.
Well aware of my surroundings,
I drank that happily.
Now I am dancing to every word you
speak,
My pushing you away and letting you
in,
the sole battle that I wouldn't win,
I want to spend decades looking into
your eyes, holding your chin.
I want you to get lost between my
legs,
If somehow, I get conscious,
I'll kiss your toxic lips.
